record.title: TRANSTHORACIC ECHOCARDIOGRAPHIC ASSESSMENTOF CARDIAC DYSFUNCTION IN DOGS WITH BABESIOSIS
record.abstract: The current study aimed to evaluate the cardiac functional parameters in canine Babesiosis patients.In this study, dogs presented to Critical Care Unit of the Department of Veterinary Clinical Medicine, Madras Veterinary College, Chennai during April 2021 to December 2021 with suspicion on canine Babesiosis were assessed with detailed clinical, hemato-biochemical, echocardiographic and electrocardiographic examination.Among 92 canine Babesiosis patients, echocardiographic examination revealed cardiac dysfunction in 31 dogs.Outof thirty one dogs, twohad systolic dysfunction, twenty four had diastolic dysfunction and 5had both systolic and diastolic dysfunction.Predominant ECG findings in cardiac dysfunction associated with canine Babesiosis patients were sinus tachycardia, ST coving and atrial fibrillation.Survival rate was lower in canine Babesiosis patient with cardiac dysfunction (26%, 8/31).Therefore, cardiac dysfunction in canine Babesiosis patients was considered as good prognostic indicator.

screening.rationale: Echocardiographic/ECG cardiac dysfunction in 92 dogs with survival association; informs cardiac involvement and outcome.
